column6: adapt: this repository's build wiring, the shape of make -C dm/host: -DGAME=<base game title ID> is required (the configure stops and lists the profiles without it; DM_GAMES_DIR honoured through dm/games/game.py), game_profile.h is generated into <build dir>/gen/<id>/ by game.py header, the host's source list comes from dm/host/Makefile through tools/host_sources.py (ours), libvpx is built from dm/third_party/libvpx, the three .S files (ASM_IN, which undef_scan.py reads) go through tools/asm_elf.py, and ANDROID_SRCS is front_android.c, vulkan_present.cpp, port_android.c (dm/host/port.h on bionic), the four compat/*.c and nvn_vk.c. Gone: DM_GEN_DIR and the D2R headers (dm_vault_tab.h, dm_hud_exp.h, dm_bright_levels.inc), the overlay contract, the touch / native-art sources; SPIRV-Tools is optional (gfx-inline off without it) and libdm.so is built only once jni_android.c (upstream's app shell, not imported) is in. Requires arm64 and ANDROID_PLATFORM >= 29 (the guest thread slots live in bionic's TLS_SLOT_APP, the app's from API 29, in an ELF TLS table: dm/host/port.h dm_kslot_*; the Vulkan 1.1 entry points vulkan_present.cpp calls directly need 28; the gate reads ANDROID_PLATFORM_LEVEL or ANDROID_PLATFORM and fails closed when neither is set under CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME Android), empties CMake's per-config flags for every build type so that C and C++ get the Makefile's -O1 -g and no NDEBUG, gives every game.py call, at configure and at build, the one DM_GAMES_DIR the cache holds (the first configure's environment, or -DDM_GAMES_DIR=) or unsets it when the cache is empty, and says when the environment and the cache differ, and runs tools/undef_scan.py (ours) at configure; apple_stubs.c (the Apple media frameworks' interfaces on bionic, each family failing with one [RED] line) is in ANDROID_SRCS with apple_stubs/include on the header path. Measured: a desktop configure (MinGW gcc) in the three GAME cases and the game_profile target; no NDK build yet.

adapt: implements this repository's dm/host/front.h for any game profile (front_run, front_metal_layer, front_screen_max_fps from the refresh rate the shell pushes in with front_android_set_refresh, front_screen_match as a no-op, front_progress to the log, front_text_input through the weak front_android_text_input a shell overrides); the fork's front_display_refresh, front_game_res, dm_pad_hook / uimsg_subscribe and the dm_touch_game_* bridge (touch_android.h, dm/ios/Sources, not imported) are gone; front_progress keeps its last title in an atomic (front.h: any thread); front_screen_max_fps is what the shell pushes with front_android_set_refresh, documented as the current mode's rate when the shell gives Display.getRefreshRate() (front.h asks for the maximum). Passes gcc -fsyntax-only with the compat include path; not yet compiled on an NDK.

adapt: the multi-viewport features for xbg_game.cpp draw_viewports (OP_VIEWPORTS, P6): the instance asks the loader for 1.2 (vkEnumerateInstanceVersion; 1.1 on an older loader), VkPhysicalDeviceMultiviewFeatures and, on a 1.2 device under a 1.2 instance, VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features are queried, and only what the device has is chained into vkCreateDevice (shaderOutputViewportIndex + shaderOutputLayer, else the VK_EXT_shader_viewport_index_layer extension when listed; multiview); dm_vk_config.shader_output_viewport_index / .multiview report it to the engine (xbg_game_set_viewport_features through nvn_vk.c), with one log line; with the 1.2 struct in the chain samplerMirrorClampToEdge is stated in it whenever the mirror-clamp extension is enabled (VUID 02832). The present blit flips its source rows when nvn_vk.c's dm_vk_present_flip says the window origin is lower-left (the engine stores the picture bottom-up then, as nvn_mtl.m does). The swapchain takes the sRGB-ness of the presented image (want_srgb / swap_srgb / is_srgb): create_swap picks the 8-bit RGBA/BGRA surface format of that encoding, skipping one without VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_BLIT_DST_BIT, and falls back to the other encoding when the device offers only that one, so that a vkCmdBlitImage between two formats of the same encoding converts neither way (the Switch scans out the stored bytes; an sRGB source in a UNORM swapchain arrived decoded once, as nvn_mtl.m's present_raw_src avoids). The Swapchain: line carries format= srgb= source_srgb=. Passes g++ -fsyntax-only with Android header shims and aarch64-linux-android29-clang++ -fsyntax-only with the NDK; not run on a device.

adapt: -g added to the engine's compile options so that a crash backtrace on the device names engine functions (the host's dm/android/CMakeLists.txt empties CMake's per-config flags, so nothing else adds it).

adapt: the State inventory is this host's (the pipeline state, viewport array, viewport_n, render-condition and transform-feedback fields added by the adaptation), field comments are stripped before parsing, and PipeMemoKey.viewports / draw_viewports() and PipeMemoKey.origin / the queue-origin front face are checked with the other memo-key slices; every rasterization and pipeline-state assignment of the draw must be in code (not swallowed by a // comment appended mid-line), and no comment appended to code may be followed by what reads as a statement (code and // or /* */ comments are split by a tokenizer that keeps string literals; ++x, x[i]=, several type words, return / break / continue and a single trailing call count); the render-condition pending check and draw / clear / submission guards, the counter types (no fatal on the type, timestamp resets apart from the samples reset), the report paths (samples reports end the pass, a query slot before every timestamp write), the zero counter field of a timestamp report and the restart mask are asserted in code.

adapt: one compatibility block at the top of the file, the tessellation case's spelling, the texture table's 256 slots and the viewport state's shape. dm/gfx/nvn/nvn_obj.h is this host's ABI, so the fork's OP_COPY_IMAGE_STRIDE (39) is named OP_XBG_COPY_IMAGE_STRIDE here, the nine OP_COUNT_+N cases ride on OP_XBG_SYNC_WAIT..OP_XBG_TYPED_CLEAR (52..60, after our OP_COUNT_ = 51), and case OP_COUNT_ (the fork's patch size) is spelled OP_XBG_PATCH_SIZE: 51 is our sentinel and no command of ours is 51. OP_BIND_TEX takes slots 0..255 (nvn_obj.h, NVN_SEPTEX_SLOT0 and the shaders' reflection), so tex is [6][256] and the two descriptor readers that capped at 128 take 256. OP_VIEWPORTS records n viewports at first, so the single viewport became viewport[16] with depth_range[2] (DEPTH_RANGE overrides the record's near/far) and viewport_n, the array's length; the handler writes viewport[first..first+n), and a draw declares and sets that many viewports and replicated scissors as dynamic state (draw_viewports(), PipeMemoKey.viewports, BindCache vpn/scn, per-viewport swizzle applied as in nvn_mtl.m) when the vertex / tessellation-evaluation / geometry shader writes ViewportIndex (XbgRasterFacts viewport_index / viewport_mask), one otherwise; multiViewport, maxViewports and the enabled shaderOutputViewportIndex (viewport_index_enabled from xbg_game_set_viewport_features, checked against viewport_index_supported / multiview_supported queried at initialization by the same two routes the front end enables: the 1.2 features on a 1.2 device under a 1.2 loader (vkEnumerateInstanceVersion, the version the front end asks the instance for), or VK_EXT_shader_viewport_index_layer) are checked, an index above 0 the game zeroed or never set is a 1x1 viewport behind an empty scissor, first_draw_covers keeps the load for a swizzled viewport 0 (the proof is not told about the flip), validate_capabilities accepts MultiViewport (57) under multiViewport and ShaderViewportIndex (70) / ShaderViewportIndexLayerEXT (5254) / SPV_EXT_shader_viewport_index_layer under the enabled feature and refuses ShaderViewportMaskNV (5255) / SPV_NV_viewport_array2 with a [RED] line, the OP_VIEWPORTS / OP_VP_SWIZZLE range checks are first <= 16 - n (no signed sum), NVN_DEVICE_INFO_MAX_VIEWPORTS answers the device's count (no caller today: the game reads hle_nvn.c's g_devinfo), and a viewport mask over several viewports is refused with a [RED] line (the multiview fan-out is open). xbg_game_set_window_origin keeps NVN's window origin (origin_ll flips every viewport about its centre at the draw, queue_origin_ll decides rs.frontFace and is in PipeMemoKey.origin, nvn_cover keeps the load under either); primitiveRestartEnable is declared only for strip and fan topologies and a restart index other than all-ones is mapped onto all-ones in a copy of the indices (the widened 8-bit stream included), after cpu_access; OP_RENDER_COND decides each of its two counter fields without resolving the GPU work mid-replay: the last pending report over a field being a timestamp report (TIMESTAMP or TIMESTAMP_TOP) at exactly that address makes it 0, any other pending report or a pending writeback over it keeps the draws (nvn_mtl.m rc_value; its rc_occ, which keeps a once-occluded address unknown for good, is not followed); OP_REPORT_COUNTER writes TIMESTAMP_TOP as a top-of-pipe timestamp and a pipeline statistic as counter 0 with one [RED] line, and OP_RESET_COUNTER ignores the other types, instead of stopping (nvn_mtl.m does not stop on them). depth_clamp, rast_discard, restart on/index and the viewport swizzles are state in PipeMemoKey's restart range wired into pipeline rasterization/input-assembly state (depthClampEnable, rasterizerDiscardEnable, primitiveRestartEnable). The draw, dispatch and texture-copy cases now read this host's records instead of the fork's: OP_DRAW / OP_DRAW_IDX go through draw_rec / draw_idx_rec and send ind / mdi_cnt to draw_indirect() (which reads the arguments at execution), OP_DISPATCH expands ind, and OP_COPY_T2T branches on DM_COPY_RESOLVE to resolve_texture(). The 12 missing handlers are implemented in execute(): OP_CLEAR_BUF, OP_DEPTH_CLAMP, OP_RENDER_COND (with skip checks in draws and clears), OP_FENCE_SYNC, OP_TF_BIND, OP_TF_STATE, OP_RAST_DISCARD, OP_VP_SWIZZLE, OP_BIND_TEX1 (via bind_rec), OP_PRIM_RESTART, OP_BIND_UBO_SMALL (via bind_buf_rec), OP_BIND_VBUF1 (via vbuf_rec). dm/gfx/vk/engine_smoke/opcode_map.txt maps every opcode and payload_mismatch.txt the payloads.

adapt: declares xbg_game_set_window_origin (NVN's window origin: the device origin flips the viewports and the present, the queue's captured origin decides the front face) and xbg_game_set_viewport_features (the mirror-clamp setter's shape): the host reports whether shaderOutputViewportIndex / shaderOutputLayer (or VK_EXT_shader_viewport_index_layer) and multiview were enabled at vkCreateDevice, which gates the viewport capabilities at shader load and the multi-viewport draw (OP_VIEWPORTS, P6).
adapt: accepts VkPipelineViewportDepthClipControlCreateInfoEXT in vp.pNext (VK_EXT_depth_clip_control) and hashes negativeOneToOne into pipeline key.

adapt: a decoration scan for BuiltIn ViewportIndex (10) and ViewportMaskNV (5253) in the pre-raster stages (0, 2, 3) fills the viewport facts before the vertex / fragment facts; the existing facts are unchanged.

adapt: XbgRasterFacts gains viewport_index / viewport_mask (the vertex, tessellation-evaluation or geometry module writes BuiltIn ViewportIndex / ViewportMaskNV), which xbg_game.cpp's draw_viewports() reads to declare the recorded viewport array (OP_VIEWPORTS with n > 1, payload P6).

adapt: implements the 27 missing mtl_* entry points (mtl_sub_fill via direct OP_CLEAR_BUF, mtl_reg_image, mtl_present_ext, mtl_link_wait_ticks, mtl_wait_acq, etc.) and fixes mtl_link_wait_tick's signature to match nvn_obj.h. 0 missing entry points and 0 differing signatures in dm/gfx/vk/engine_smoke/abi_gaps.txt. dm_vk_initialize calls xbg_game_set_viewport_features(config->shader_output_viewport_index, config->multiview) after the mirror-clamp setter, before any shader load (the viewport capabilities of OP_VIEWPORTS P6 are gated on it; -2 is a [RED] line, not a failed initialization). mtl_display_hz reads front.h's front_screen_max_fps (the fork's front_display_refresh is not in this repository's front.h). Defines the Metal replay's diagnostics the host calls (hle_nvn.c [nvn] lines, hle_hid.c DM_CTL dumps, main.c DM_PSO_PREBUILD): the engine's real totals where it has them, otherwise 0 with a one-time [RED] "not collected / not implemented on this platform"; texdump arms xbg_game_capture_frame only before the first submission (the engine refuses it afterwards) and at runtime says [RED] not implemented; nvn_cap_submit / nvn_cap_present (nvn_capture.h, called by hle_nvn.c, defined only in the Metal nvn_capture.inc) are no-ops that say [RED] once when DM_NVN_CAPTURE is set; each not-collected statistic is named once (docs/reference/android.md, The Android link lacks the Metal replay's diagnostics). mtl_set_origin_lower_left / mtl_set_queue_origin_lower_left drive xbg_game_set_window_origin and dm_vk_present_flip (read by vulkan_present.cpp); mtl_set_depth_zero is kept and a game that keeps the GL depth mode (near = -w) gets one [RED] at its first submission: the Vulkan bundles have no near = -w entry point, not implemented.

adapt: dm_vk_config gains shader_output_viewport_index and multiview (what the front end enabled at vkCreateDevice for the multi-viewport draw), passed to xbg_game_set_viewport_features by nvn_vk.c as sampler_mirror_clamp_to_edge is; the size check covers them on both sides.
